description: Scheduled visits from a provider's Jobber Client Hub, grouped Today / Upcoming / Past. Each visit carries date, weekday, time, arrival window, location and confirmation state. `time` is null when the provider chooses not to show times. `start`/`end` keep only visits dated in that inclusive range. Read-only.

end.description: Latest visit date to include, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).

hub.description: Which provider hub to read, by label. Omit when only one is configured.

start.description: Earliest visit date to include, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).

view.description: "full" (default) returns the records; "brief" returns one line per visit: title — <ISO date or "no date"> — <today|upcoming|past>[, confirmed].

name: jobber_list_appointments
title: List scheduled visits
